note: The root key uses the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Havilah is the land around which the Pishon flows. Genesis 2:11 describes it as a place where gold is found.

senses.definition: The land named in the description of the Pishon’s course.

evidence.note: The Pishon flows around כָּל אֶרֶץ הַחֲוִילָה, “the whole land of Havilah.”
